g.text: Complete native age profiles | 2019 and 2022 | counts, not rates
U.S. cases selected from all 51 regions by the lowest/highest 2022 ages 20-24 net-rate point estimate; the same regions are retained in 2019.
U.S. net-count MOEs omit unknown covariance; both 2022 total intervals include zero. Case ranks are point estimates, with ranking uncertainty unmeasured.
Japan: annual registered inter-prefectural moves, all nationalities. U.S.: ACS 1-year interstate residence changes, age at interview. Native bins differ.
Separate count scales. Tokyo means JP-13; DC is a federal district and New Hampshire a state, not equivalent urban cores. Sources: official annual files / ACS.
